text: A STEPPER STAGE MARKED AS AN ERROR SHOWS AS ONE EVEN WHEN IT IS THE CURRENT STAGE. `current` used to win over a step's own `status`, so a process that stopped at a stage — a payment returned at the Pay & Accounts Office — drew that stage as an ordinary current one, in brand blue, beside a red alert saying it had failed. An explicit `status: "error"` now wins; the stage keeps `aria-current="step"`, so a screen reader still hears where the process stands.
